name: Gmail Ingest
description: Import Gmail messages carrying a configured label into Trilium, including HTML/text content and attachments.
author: Ian Sherr

settings.title: Google OAuth client ID
settings.description: OAuth 2.0 Web application client ID from Google Cloud Console.

settings.title: Google OAuth client secret
settings.description: OAuth 2.0 client secret. Keep this private to this Trilium instance.

settings.title: OAuth redirect URI
settings.description: Exact callback URL. Recommended behind a reverse proxy. Leave blank to infer https://host/custom/gmail-ingest/oauth/callback from the current request and its forwarded headers.

settings.title: Import parent note ID
settings.description: Trilium note ID under which imported email notes will be created. The default is root.

settings.title: Gmail ingest label
settings.description: Messages with this Gmail label are imported.

settings.title: Gmail done label
settings.description: This Gmail label is added after successful import, and the ingest label is removed.

settings.title: Maximum messages per account per run
settings.description: The hourly worker processes at most this many messages for each connected account.

settings.title: Maximum attachment size
settings.description: Attachments larger than this are skipped with a warning in the imported note. Default: 25 MiB.

settings.title: Manual sync endpoint secret
settings.description: Required before connecting an account or syncing manually, because custom endpoints are public when backend scripting is enabled. Use a long random value.

settings.title: Connected Gmail accounts
settings.description: Managed by the Connect Gmail account button. Do not edit this field manually.

artifacts.title: Gmail Ingest OAuth and sync endpoint
